statement: H6: copying Decu's verified wallet (4vw54...) on the bonding curve with a ~1 s delay is profitable after costs.
measurable_definition: MirrorWallet(wallet=4vw54BmAogeRV3vPKWyFet5yf8DTLcREzdSzx4rw9Ud9, size_sol=0.5, max_hold_s=900): buy 0.5 SOL when the wallet opens a position, mirror its sells, 900-s time stop; curve only. Execution: 1 s latency, 125 bps, 0.005 SOL priority+tip/tx, 20% slippage tolerance, 2% failure. First test: 17:45-19:15 UTC (validation-period data recorded after registration). Pass: expectancy > 0, PF > 1.2, >= 8 trades (Decu makes ~5-8 entries/h when active; a weak test by sample size). Reported only: latency 0.1-10 s.
rationale: Decu was chosen as a seed before any data. Their picks beat the creator-dump candidates they skipped (choice-set study) and their stream session netted ~+89 SOL across venues. On the full train period, a 1-s copier of their curve trades made +0.92 SOL on 16 trades (PF 1.51), with +4.29 at 0.5 s and +1.13 at 5 s, while copying most other top wallets lost. The earlier all-negative copy result came from a sampled slot clock. Parameters are the standard copy setup used throughout, not fitted.
note: If H5 fails and H6 passes, H6 takes the holdout under the same rule as in holdout_plan.md (with >= 8 trades); if both pass, H5 (registered first) takes it.
